title: Weakly supervised deep learning evaluates microvascular invasion in HCC slides
summary: A weakly supervised multiple-instance learning model, MVI-DL, was trained on 350 HCC patients (2917 slides) and tested on 120 patients (504 slides) from other hospitals, using only tumor tissue. AUC was 0.904 in the home test set and 0.871 in the external test set, and 0.875 and 0.879 when simulating single-slide and biopsy-only cases. Interpretation highlighted macrotrabecular architecture, rich stroma and intratumor heterogeneity as key features.
ai_technology: Weakly supervised multiple-instance learning deep learning on whole-slide images (MVI-DL)
